scope: Actual module with lightweight DOM and deterministic fake YouTube IFrame API; no browser/network validation

results.name: Players load lazily; initial markup uses source time
Ready enables audio once and chapters retain source offsets
Native seek before requested start displays and resumes the same source time
Custom slider seeks an absolute source time including before the chapter start
Native mute and volume preferences survive chapter changes and custom pause/resume
Starting another YouTube video pauses the previous one
Leaving the section cancels an in-flight request and pauses playback
Inactive native play and hidden document cannot continue playback
